author: Codex
scope: D1 heap-image writer and loader with explicit relocations and root bindings. No process READY or LL15 slot credit.
observations: O-41: Heap-key relocation requires a directed case in the READY packet; the reviewed images have pinned symbol keys.
O-42: Relocation validates object boundaries and tags, not the intended identity. The owner and image records remain trusted.
O-43: The recognized-kind inventory bounds admitted images; new worklist kinds require explicit support.
